data.body:
Wrong premise; this ticket will be closed as obsolete. Operator intent (2026-11-12): both plan-review engines stay available permanently, selected by `[verify] plan_review_engine`, and no engine is retired.

The close is blocked for now because the `# mechanism-ok:` marker at `src/rebar/_config_sections.py:57` names this ticket as its sunset ticket. `dashing-fluidal-crustacean` rewrites that marker with a permanent reason that cites ADR 0123. Once that change merges, this ticket closes with `--class obsolete`. Do not implement it.
